title: The Mereon boundary is the three-dimensional shadow of the 600-cell

statements.text: Every vertex direction of the 120-face Mereon boundary is the stereographic image of an element of the binary icosahedral group, matched vertex by vertex, so that boundary is the $H_3$ shadow of the $H_4$-symmetric 600-cell, and $E_6$, $E_7$ and $E_8$ are realized geometrically.

sources.quote: The M120p is thus the H3 shadow of the H4 -symmetric 600-cell
